correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, singleton deletion descendants force t+2s<=n-1; adjacent supports at neighboring starts conflict, forcing t<=floor(n/2); integer elimination gives M<=floor((3n-2)/4). A periodic support construction has exactly floor(n/2)+floor((n-1)/4) words and disjoint singleton and two-one deletion descendants by explicit coordinate cases. The modified-VT residue-class count follows from the involution u->r-u on Z_(n-1) with exactly one duplicated coordinate residue. Boundaries n=2..5 and zero deletion positions were checked, and the standalone program passed all specified independent finite tests. Finite checks do not prove the unbounded result; the combinatorial steps do.

value.rationale: The exact weight-two constant-composition deletion-coding capacity is a motivated fundamental invariant of a classic synchronization-error model. The formula settles all blocklengths, gives a constructive optimum, and quantifies a genuine design gap: the maximum code is asymptotically 50 percent larger than any individual class of a classical optimum coloring. The result is not a numerical increment, a relabeling, or an unsupported application; it determines sharp code size with an all-length obstruction and matching construction.
